description: Quiero hacer una historía de lo que pasó con el elicoptero Ingenuity abandonado en Marte.
summary: The Cumbal Project was developed around the space junk that space engineering is leaving behind in space and on some celestial bodies, such as the Moon, Venus, and Mars: spacecraft that never worked, others that stopped working, and others like the Ingenuity helicopter, which can no longer fly but still serves as a machine collecting climate data from one region of the planet. We want to share this story in more everyday language, so that everyone, from children to adults, can understand it.
details:
This project aims to share some of the aerospace engineering being developed around the world. Since the mid-20th century, enormous numbers of satellites have been left in space, and right now Colombia is left without a satellite in orbit.

This project is inspired by the goal of offering information to the Pastos Indigenous people, who have very little access to this kind of scientific information. It tells how the first helicopter flew on Mars despite its conditions: the distance, the thinness of its atmosphere, and a whole set of factors that scientists and engineers had to overcome to take this craft there.
